text.limitation: Browser/GDI fallback glyphs are adaptations if the original font is unavailable.

money_total.format: decimal left-padded with zero to 9 digits

notifications.text_formula: actor_type<4: skill_index==-1 ? actor_name : skill_name; type6: x%d(value); other>=4: item_name
notifications.source_item_index_note: 50D450 item-name branch uses type payload directly as zero-based index. Preserve raw source record; do not silently reinterpret item IDs.
notifications.visibility: Active records draw whenever Victor has finished; phase 2 is not required.
notifications.ordering: Draw insertion order; active earlier records remain. Same actor notifications occupy the same y and later records cover earlier ones.

report.update: If x<target, when (step_count&3)!=0 and dx>10: dx-=dx>>2; step_count++; x+=dx. Otherwise clamp x=target and mark slide complete.

counters.update: For each unfinished record on its clock: displayed_value++; remaining--; player EXP++/NEXT--. At role threshold call 518B60 and enqueue role-level notice. Phase remains1 while any counter unfinished.
counters.skip: 50E070 consumes all remaining values, loops all earned role levels, and adds each role-level notification.

notifications.ordinal: count of all previously enqueued records with same actor/type byte
notifications.advance: Snap active unfinished records to target/done; activate each unfinished record whose ordinal==page+1; increment page once if any were activated.
notifications.done: Motion completion means x has reached280; it does not erase active records.

latch.limit: 50E280 early intro-skip returns before setting this latch. Browser uses Space physical edges uniformly to satisfy the requested no-repeat behavior.

phases.behavior: Victor not complete: skip Victor only; else force report to target, finish every counter and move to phase2.
If any notification is unfinished, advance notification group; otherwise free assets and leave battle result.

input.final_confirmation: One later press after all notifications are done exits; same press which advances pending records cannot exit.
input.browser_adapter: Space keydown physical edge only; ignore repeat, release before next advance.

embedded_victor_action.limitation: Result update/draw routines do not explicitly dispatch this sound. Original victory sound playback was not observed; autoplay is a renderer adapter, not a native playback claim.

limitations: No original executable gameplay was run or observed.
Static reported coordinates and message gates are source facts; browser frame scheduling and font fallback remain adapters.
RGB565 masked blending and indexed additive layers are represented in Canvas 8-bit color; native per-channel LUT rounding is not reproduced.
Fight_Report.mnu is preserved as a source menu but the confirmed battle renderer uses the DGP plate; MNU presence alone does not establish a battle draw caller.
Embedded victory sound token is preserved without claiming original playback.
